### ✨ MH Outlanders Mod Menu (v1.0.2)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (No Damage)** — Zeroes all monster direct & physical damage to player.
- **1-Hit Kill Monsters** — Drops enemy HP to 0 on hit (respects phase locks).
- **Damage Multiplier** — Scales health damage dealt to enemies.
- **Effective ATK Boost** — Multiplies character EffectiveAttack stat.
- **Instant Part Break** — Breaks/severs monster breakable parts in one hit.
- **Freeze Monster HP** — Monsters take 0 HP damage (combo testing dummy).
- **Check Hook & Slide Status** — Verify live ASLR slide & hooked monster addresses.

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
